map.计算两个向量的点积（内积）: Compute the dot product (inner product) of two vectors
map.点积为 0 说明两向量正交: A dot product of 0 means the two vectors are orthogonal
map.可用于相似度、投影与夹角计算: Usable for similarity, projection and angle calculations

map.做推荐或检索时衡量相似度：把两个特征向量做点积（或归一化后的余弦），判断它们方向: Measure similarity in recommendation or retrieval: take the dot product of two feature vectors (or the cosine after normalization) to judge how close their directions are.

map.结合模长可反推夹角：cosθ = 点积 /（|a||b|）: With magnitudes you can back out the angle: cosθ = dot / (|a||b|)

map.点积和余弦相似度是一回事吗？: Are the dot product and cosine similarity the same?
map.不完全。点积 = |a||b|cosθ，会受向量长度影响；余弦相似度再除以两个模: Not quite. The dot product = |a||b|cosθ is affected by vector length; cosine similarity divides by both magnitudes and keeps only direction. So to compare 'how close the directions are' use cosine (e.g. text similarity), while the dot product also encodes length and direction, suiting cases that need magnitude too (e.g. attention weights).
